朝鮮國勢調査報告 1935 全鮮編

Chōsen kokusei chōsa hōkoku, Shōwa 10-nen, zensen-hen: kekkahyō oyobi kijutsu hōbun (Report of the 1935 Census of Korea, Whole Country: Result Tables and Descriptive Report), as of 1 October 1935
朝鮮總督府, 京城, 1939

All 35 result tables and the tables and lists in the descriptive report are transcribed (123 tables, about 96,000 figure cells); the prose is not. Each spread was read once by a Claude Sonnet agent from tight crops; where a digit was blurred in the NDL scan, the agent read it from the second copy on Commons and noted it. 47 figures that could not be read in either copy, but which a printed total fixes exactly (one unknown, every other figure in the sum read), are filled in and shown with a blue background (inferred), each with a note; 10 cells stay [?]. Printed totals were re-added; those that do not add up are kept as printed and noted (in table 4 eleven county totals differ from the sum of their 面 rows by a few units), and where a digit was ambiguous only between 3 and 8 and exactly one reading made a printed total reconcile, that reading is used and noted.
